outline:
1.光纖概論，2.光纖波導，3.光纖傳輸特特性，4.光纖與光纜，5.光纖連接，6.光源與檢光器，7.光纖系統，8.光纖量測，9.光纖應用與未來發展。
輔助教材包括
1. Introduction to the broadband network system.
2. Introduction to the Laser diode driver FL500.
3. Installation of the laser diode driver FL500.
4. Practice of the laser diode driver FL500.
5. Practice of the CWDM MQW-DFB laser diode modules.
6. Practice of the RF current feedback amplifiers.
7. Practice of the NPN silicon planar epitaxial transistors.
8. Practice of the PLC splitter modules.
9. Introduction to the USB controlled dual-channel laser diode driver FL593.
10. Installation of the USB controlled dual-channel laser diode driver FL593.
11. Practice of the USB controlled dual-channel laser diode driver FL593.
